name: Patterns_EA
summary: Patterns_EA is an Expert Advisor that detects classic Japanese candlestick patterns (such as Engulfing, Hammer, Doji, etc.) and automatically enters trades based on those pattern signals. It applies technical confirmation filters to reduce false signals and manages open positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA operates systematically, scanning for pattern formations on each new bar and executing trades without manual intervention.
summary_zh: Patterns_EA是一个基于经典日本K线形态（如吞没形态、锤子线、十字星等）自动识别并开仓交易的Expert Advisor。它通过技术确认过滤器减少假信号，并使用止损和止盈管理持仓。该EA系统化运行，在每个新K线形成时扫描形态并自动执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别经典的日本K线形态，如看涨/看跌吞没形态、锤子线、倒锤子线、晨星/暮星等反转信号。入场条件为：当EA检测到有效的K线形态完成后，结合可选的趋势过滤器（如移动平均线方向）确认，在形态确认后的下一根K线开盘时入场。出场条件包括固定止损止盈、形态失效止损以及可选的移动止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数方式。资金管理方面，EA提供风险百分比参数控制每笔交易的最大亏损比例，并设有最大持仓数量限制以防止过度暴露。该策略的优势在于K线形态是经过长期验证的价格行为信号，具有直观的市场心理含义，但劣势是K线形态在震荡市中容易产生大量假信号，需要趋势过滤器的配合使用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to identify classic Japanese candlestick patterns such as bullish/bearish engulfing, hammer, inverted hammer, morning/evening star and other reversal signals. Entry conditions: when the EA detects a valid completed candlestick pattern, it optionally confirms with a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) before entering on the next bar's open. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit, pattern-invalidation stops, and an optional trailing stop. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based lot calculation derived from account balance. Money management incorporates a risk percentage parameter to control the maximum loss per trade, along with a maximum open positions limit to prevent overexposure. The strategy's strength lies in candlestick patterns being time-tested price action signals with intuitive market psychology meaning, but its weakness is that candlestick patterns generate many false signals in ranging markets, requiring trend filter cooperation for reliable performance.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop points; activates when price reaches this distance

pros: 基于经典K线形态，策略逻辑透明且经过长期市场验证
提供趋势过滤器有效减少震荡行情中的假信号
具备完整的风险管理机制，包括止损止盈和最大持仓限制
参数设计灵活，支持固定手数和风险百分比两种仓位模式
支持多种K线形态识别，策略覆盖面广
pros_en: Based on classic candlestick patterns with transparent strategy logic verified over decades of market data
Trend filter effectively reduces false signals in ranging/sideways markets
Complete risk management mechanism including stop-loss, take-profit, and maximum position limits
Flexible parameter design supporting both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing modes
Supports multiple candlestick pattern recognition providing broad strategy coverage
cons: K线形态在震荡市中仍可能产生较多假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏市场波动率(如ATR)自适应机制，止损止盈为固定点数不够灵活
未包含点差过滤，在小周期或高点差品种上可能不利
形态识别依赖单根或少量K线，缺少多周期确认提高可靠性
未实现交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: Candlestick patterns can still generate excessive false signals in choppy/ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks ATR-based adaptive mechanism; fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit are inflexible across different volatility regimes
No spread filter included, potentially disadvantageous on lower timeframes or high-spread instruments
Pattern recognition relies on single or few candles, missing multi-timeframe confirmation for improved reliability
No trading session filter implemented, potentially causing unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整出场水平
添加多时间框架确认机制，在更高周期趋势方向一致时才开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts exit levels based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation requiring higher-timeframe trend alignment before entering positions
Implement spread filter and trading session filter to avoid high-cost and low-liquidity period trading

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在极端波动行情中可能不足，存在单笔亏损超出预期的风险
K线形态信号在无趋势行情中频繁触发可能导致连续小额亏损累积
缺乏点差过滤器在高点差环境下可能导致实盘滑点成本显著增加
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may be insufficient during extreme volatility, risking larger-than-expected single-trade losses
Candlestick pattern signals fire frequently in trendless markets, potentially accumulating consecutive small losses
Lack of spread filter can cause significant real-world slippage cost increase in high-spread environments
